replies.author: JKawesome
replies.body: This is just my opinion, so please don't hate on me for this. I really think TNT does not fit well in Nebula at all. Classic nebula is mainly placing wood, bridging, and PvP. It is a solid map, with only players able to do anything by hand. Now we have these maps with redstone contraptions and TNT, and it kind of defeats the purpose. I mean, you don't even have to try in Cherryland. If you want to defend, just blow up the bridge that leads to the monument, as well as other bridges. You can even blow up your own clouds to prevent easy skybridging. If you want to rush, you can just leave a trail of TNT behind you, and light them at the end. If the TNT was removed from Cherryland, it would be an amazing map to rush and defend on.

replies.author: Zintenka
replies.body:
Keep the TNT. CherryLandMC is my most fav map because of the TNT. Its a new thing to the server and ppl should adapt.

If you really do not like the map and its TNT then just go to Nebula Large rots. Cherry isnt in those rots. 

Perhaps here are a few suggestions that might make ppl like the map better:
  • Make a build limit Just below the clouds 
  • Add anti-greif filters or whatever (Para is already trying this)
  • Replace the gold with iron for better defense against TNT
  • Spawn with explosion resistent armor (enchants)
  • Add more chests with redstone supplies and TNT supplies
Personally, i like the map the way it is. Its just a pet peeve with the cloud and chest parts. Other than that, many ppl here agree that it should be left alone.
